days.title: Journey, Check-in, Rest, Sunset at Raja's Seat & Temple Darshan
days.summary: Depart home at 5:45 AM, board the KSRTC EV Power Plus from Kengeri TTMC with an en route highway breakfast break, and arrive in Madikeri by 1:00 PM. Check in at Treebo Doha King, enjoy a pure vegetarian lunch at Udupi The Veg, book Saturday's 4x4 jeep safari, and take a 1.5-hour afternoon rest. Head to Raja's Seat for daylight views, golden hour, and sunset, followed by an illuminated evening visit to Shri Omkareshwara Swamy Temple and a relaxed vegetarian dinner.
checklist: Book an auto from JDR Aadhitri by 05:35 AM to reach Kengeri TTMC by 05:55 AM
Keep KSRTC PNR (KS22879177) and Government IDs ready for conductor verification
Inspect room linens and geyser at Treebo Doha King before heading to lunch
Lock in the 4x4 jeep at the taxi stand next to the bus stand during lunch for the Saturday 06:00 AM Mandalpatti pickup
Carry a light windbreaker or umbrella for cool evening breeze and mist at Raja's Seat
Keep physical cash handy for local Madikeri auto rides (₹50 per trip)

timeline.title: Auto from Home to Kengeri TTMC
timeline.description: Leave from Home by auto (approx. 2.8 km, 10–12 min drive) to reach Kengeri BMTC TTMC bus bay by 05:55 AM, giving a comfortable 25-minute buffer before departure.

timeline.title: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus (Kengeri to Highway Stop)
timeline.description: Board KSRTC EV Power Plus (Trip Code: 0530BNGMRC, PNR: KS22879177, Seats: 13, 14) from Kengeri TTMC platform. Enjoy a smooth cruise along the Bengaluru–Mysuru Expressway.

timeline.title: En Route Highway Breakfast Stop
timeline.description: Bus halts for a scheduled 25–30 minute breakfast break at a pure veg highway food plaza along the expressway / bypass (Maddur/Mandya stretch). Enjoy hot thatte idli, vada, masala dosa, and filter coffee.

timeline.title: Scenic Ghat Journey to Madikeri
timeline.description: Resume the journey cruising past Mysuru, Hunsur, and Kushalnagar, ascending through the lush Western Ghats into Kodagu district.

timeline.title: Arrival at Madikeri & Check-in at Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Alight at Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand. Take a 2-minute stroll (200–300 meters) directly behind the station to Treebo Doha King. Complete check-in, inspect room linens and geyser, unpack, and freshen up.

timeline.title: Pure Vegetarian Lunch & 4x4 Jeep Reservation
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes to Udupi The Veg for a hot South Indian lunch (akki roti with saagu, neer dosa, or thali). Right next to the bus terminal, coordinate with the taxi/jeep stand to lock in Saturday's 06:00 AM Mandalpatti + Abbey Falls circuit (target ₹2,200–₹2,500; note driver contact).
timeline.location: Udupi The Veg & Madikeri Jeep Stand

timeline.title: Midday Rest & Refresh at Hotel
timeline.description: Return to Treebo Doha King for an uninterrupted 1.5-hour rest to recharge from the 6-hour morning road journey.

timeline.title: Auto to Raja's Seat
timeline.description: Hire a local auto from the hotel/bus stand area up to Raja's Seat viewpoint.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Raja's Seat

timeline.title: Raja's Seat Gardens, Sunset & Musical Fountain
timeline.description: Stroll through the manicured flower gardens with clear valley vistas. Enjoy the cool hillside breeze during golden hour, watch the sunset over the Western Ghats around 06:15 PM, and stay for the musical fountain show at dusk.

timeline.title: Auto to Shri Omkareshwara Swamy Temple
timeline.description: Take a short auto ride across town from Raja's Seat down to Omkareshwara Temple.

timeline.title: Omkareshwara Temple Evening Darshan & Pond Walk
timeline.description: Experience the temple during evening darshan with deepas (oil lamps) lit. Admire the unique Gothic-Islamic dome and minaret architecture, participate in evening aarti, and take a peaceful walk around the central water tank.

timeline.title: Auto to Hotel / Bus Stand Area
timeline.description: Take an auto back from Omkareshwara Temple to the bus stand area near the hotel.

timeline.title: Pure Veg Dinner at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting, light pure vegetarian dinner (dosa, bisibelebath, or South Indian meals) without any rush.

timeline.title: Walk back to Hotel & Early Rest
timeline.description: Take a 2-minute stroll back to Treebo Doha King, prep warm layers for the open-jeep safari, and get a good night's sleep for the 05:30 AM wakeup.

days.title: 4x4 Jeep Safari, Abbey Falls, Fort, Temples, Royal Tombs & Specialty Coffee
days.summary: Embark on an early-morning 4x4 off-road jeep safari to Mandalpatti Peak and Abbey Falls, returning to Madikeri by 1:00 PM with a built-in traffic buffer. After a pure vegetarian lunch and a quick 45-minute refresh at Treebo Doha King, explore Madikeri Fort & Museum, take darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, tour the royal mausoleums at Gaddige, and enjoy an evening specialty brew tasting at Ainmane Coffee before an early dinner.
checklist: Wear warm windcheaters or jackets for the breezy open 4x4 jeep safari
Wear sturdy walking shoes with good traction for wet rocky pathways around Abbey Falls
Carry ₹2,500 - ₹3,000 cash for the private 4x4 jeep driver, entry tickets, and forest eco-tax
Keep physical cash handy for afternoon auto rides to Fort, Gaddige, and Ainmane (₹50-₹70 per trip)

timeline.title: Early Wakeup & Hot Coffee
timeline.description: Wake up to brisk mountain air at Treebo Doha King, grab hot coffee or tea in the room, and have light dry biscuits or snacks for the bumpy trail.

timeline.title: Board 4x4 Jeep to Mandalpatti Peak
timeline.description: Board your pre-booked 4x4 jeep right at Treebo Doha King. Head north through the misty hills, transitioning onto the rugged off-road forest trail ascending toward Mandalpatti.

timeline.title: Mandalpatti Peak Summit & Cloud Views
timeline.description: Witness 360-degree panoramic views overlooking the Pushpagiri Wildlife Sanctuary shrouded in early-morning mist and clouds before holiday crowds build up.

timeline.title: Scenic Jeep Descent to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Descend the mountain track, branching onto the shaded interior road leading directly toward Abbey Falls.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Exploration & Hanging Bridge
timeline.description: Walk down the stepped paved trail through dense pepper vines, cardamom plants, and coffee trees. Take in the roaring cascade from the hanging suspension footbridge.

timeline.title: Jeep Return to Hotel (with Traffic Buffer)
timeline.description: Drive back toward Madikeri. A generous 1 hour 45 minute buffer absorbs holiday traffic on the narrow approach road, safely dropping you back at Treebo Doha King around 12:45 PM – 01:00 PM. Settle the jeep balance with the driver.
timeline.location: Abbey Falls to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Pure Veg Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes to Udupi The Veg or Hotel Capitol's veg section for a hot South Indian meal, akki roti with veg saagu, or neer dosa.

timeline.title: Quick Refresh & Rest at Hotel
timeline.description: Return to your room at Treebo Doha King for 45 minutes to shower, wash off trail dust, change into fresh clothes, and recharge phones.

timeline.title: Auto to Madikeri Fort
timeline.description: Take a 5-minute auto ride from the hotel/bus stand area up to the fort gates (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Explore Madikeri Fort & Government Museum
timeline.description: Walk the 17th-century stone ramparts, photograph the two life-sized stone elephant sculptures, and tour the state archaeological museum housed inside the Gothic St. Mark's Church.

timeline.title: Darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple
timeline.description: Walk directly across the fort gateway courtyard to the historic Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple. Offer prayers at this ancient shrine deeply associated with the Kodagu Rajas and Madikeri Dasara.
timeline.location: Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Auto to Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Hire an auto outside the fort gate heading straight north through Mahadevpet up to Gaddige (approx. 2.2 km).

timeline.title: Tour Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Explore the 18th-century Indo-Saracenic royal mausoleums of King Lingarajendra II and Doddaveerarajendra, strolling the manicured garden grounds in bright late-afternoon light.

timeline.title: Auto to Ainmane Coffee Experience Centre
timeline.description: Take an auto from Gaddige back toward town down to College Road (approx. 2.5 km).

timeline.title: Specialty Coffee Tasting at Ainmane
timeline.description: Unwind inside the flagship Ainmane Coffee Experience Centre. Sample single-origin estate brews (such as Monsooned Malabar), try local fruit preserves, and browse artisan chocolate displays.

timeline.title: Relaxed Town Stroll
timeline.description: Stroll through the town center at a leisurely pace to enjoy the Dasara festive lights and evening buzz.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Dinner
timeline.description: Enjoy a wholesome, warm South Indian dinner (ghee roast dosa, bisibelebath, or meals) at Atithi Restaurant or Udupi The Veg.

timeline.title: Walk back to Hotel & Early Rest
timeline.description: Take the short 2-minute stroll back to Treebo Doha King. Pack main bags leisurely for tomorrow's checkout and turn in early for a solid night of rest.

additionalBudget.title: Forest Department Mandalpatti Entry & Eco Tax

timeline.title: Warm Hotel Breakfast
timeline.description: Wake up at a leisurely pace and enjoy a hot breakfast at the hotel to wait out early morning mist or heavy rainfall.

timeline.title: Covered Cab to Abbey Falls
timeline.description: Instead of an open 4x4 jeep to rugged mountain ridges, hire a covered closed cab to visit Abbey Falls.

timeline.title: Abbey Falls Sightseeing
timeline.description: Enjoy the dramatic roaring waterfall from the covered viewpoints and hanging suspension bridge.

timeline.title: Cab Return to Madikeri Town
timeline.description: Drive back from Abbey Falls to Treebo Doha King by covered cab, avoiding the rain.
timeline.location: Abbey Falls to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Pure Veg Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes to Udupi The Veg or Hotel Capitol's veg section for a warm South Indian thali, akki roti, or hot dosa.

timeline.title: Quick Refresh & Rest at Hotel
timeline.description: Return to your room at Treebo Doha King for 45 minutes to freshen up, change clothes, and relax.

timeline.title: Auto to Madikeri Fort
timeline.description: Take a 5-minute auto ride from the hotel/bus stand area up to the fort gates (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Explore Madikeri Fort & Government Museum
timeline.description: Explore the historical exhibits sheltered inside the Gothic St. Mark's Church archaeological museum and view the fort grounds.

timeline.title: Darshan at Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple
timeline.description: Walk across to the sheltered courtyard of Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple right at the fort gate for evening prayers.
timeline.location: Kote Maha Ganapathi Temple, Madikeri Fort

timeline.title: Auto to Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: Take an auto northward through Mahadevpet up to Gaddige (approx. 2.2 km).

timeline.title: Tour Gaddige (Raja's Tomb)
timeline.description: View the royal Indo-Saracenic mausoleums and surrounding lawns.

timeline.title: Auto to Ainmane Coffee Experience Centre
timeline.description: Take an auto from Gaddige down to College Road (approx. 2.5 km).

timeline.title: Specialty Coffee Tasting at Ainmane
timeline.description: Warm up inside with estate-brewed hot coffee, local snacks, and specialty chocolate shopping.

timeline.title: Relaxed Town Stroll
timeline.description: Take a gentle umbrella stroll through the illuminated town center if the rain eases up.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Dinner
timeline.description: Enjoy a comforting, hot vegetarian dinner at Atithi Restaurant or Udupi The Veg.

timeline.title: Walk back to Hotel & Early Rest
timeline.description: Stroll 2 minutes back to Treebo Doha King to pack and rest early.

days.title: Military Heritage, Checkout, Spice Shopping & Return Bus
days.summary: Start Sunday with a fresh South Indian breakfast and an early morning tour of the General Thimayya Memorial Museum ('Sunny Side') to view the MiG-21 and military artifacts. Complete checkout at Treebo Doha King before 11:00 AM, store bags at the front desk, and enjoy dedicated, hands-free spice and chocolate shopping in the town bazaar. After an early pure veg lunch at Udupi The Veg, collect luggage and walk across to Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand to board the 01:30 PM Airavat Club Class bus back to Bengaluru.
checklist: Complete room packing and front desk checkout at Treebo Doha King by 10:45 AM
Hand over luggage to hotel reception for safe cloakroom storage during shopping and lunch
Keep KSRTC return PNR (KS22879259) and government IDs accessible on phone
Purchase whole black pepper, green cardamom, Coorg honey, and fresh filter coffee powder during the bazaar walk
Ensure you reach Platform 0 at Madikeri Bus Stand by 01:10 PM for the 01:30 PM Airavat departure

timeline.title: Pure Veg Breakfast & Filter Coffee
timeline.description: Walk 2 minutes to Udupi The Veg for a piping-hot breakfast (thatte idli-vada, masala dosa, and traditional Kumbakonam/filter coffee) to fuel the morning.

timeline.title: Auto to General Thimayya Memorial Museum
timeline.description: Take a 5-minute auto hop from the town center up to 'Sunny Side' (approx. 1.2 km).
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to General Thimayya Memorial Museum

timeline.title: Tour General Thimayya Memorial Museum (Sunny Side)
timeline.description: Explore the ancestral home of former Chief of Army Staff General K.S. Thimayya. Inspect the decommissioned IAF MiG-21 fighter jet, the Indian Army T-55 battle tank, military artillery, medals, and historical war galleries.

timeline.title: Auto back to Treebo Doha King
timeline.description: Take an auto from the museum back to the hotel area.
timeline.location: General Thimayya Memorial Museum to Treebo Doha King

timeline.title: Pack Bags & Official Hotel Checkout
timeline.description: Conduct a final sweep of the room for chargers and belongings, complete checkout at Treebo Doha King before 11:00 AM, and deposit luggage with the front desk reception cloak storage.

timeline.title: Hands-Free Spice & Market Shopping
timeline.description: Stroll hands-free through Madikeri central bazaar. Shop for GI-tagged whole black pepper, green cardamom pods, pure Coorg wild honey, handmade fruit chocolates, and fresh roasted coffee blends.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Lunch at Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy an unhurried, nourishing pure vegetarian South Indian thali or lunch at Udupi The Veg before long-distance transit.

timeline.title: Collect Luggage & Walk to Bus Stand
timeline.description: Collect stored luggage from Treebo Doha King reception and take the flat 2-minute walk (200 meters) across to Platform 0 of the Madikeri KSRTC Bus Stand. Board by 01:15 PM.
timeline.location: Treebo Doha King to KSRTC Bus Stand

timeline.title: Board KSRTC Airavat Club Class to Bengaluru
timeline.description: Depart Madikeri on KSRTC Airavat Club Class (Trip Code: 1002MNGBNG, PNR: KS22879259, Seats: 5, 6). Relax through the ghat descent via Kushalnagar, Hunsur bypass, and the expressway back toward Bengaluru.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri BMTC TTMC
timeline.description: Alight at Kengeri BMTC TTMC flyover bus bay. Collect luggage from the undercarriage hold.

timeline.title: Auto from Kengeri TTMC to Home
timeline.description: Take a local auto from Kengeri TTMC back home to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya (approx. 2.8 km).
timeline.location: Kengeri TTMC to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya

timeline.title: Relaxed Breakfast at Hotel / Udupi The Veg
timeline.description: Enjoy a warm South Indian breakfast nearby without rushing through early morning showers.

timeline.title: Indoor Tour of General Thimayya Museum
timeline.description: Take an auto directly to Sunny Side to explore the indoor military artifacts, medals, and uniforms under cover.

timeline.title: Hotel Checkout & Luggage Drop
timeline.description: Return to Treebo Doha King, complete check-out, and store bags safely at the front desk.

timeline.title: Covered Emporium & Spice Shopping
timeline.description: Shop inside covered government and estate spice emporiums for spices, chocolates, and coffee powder away from the rain.

timeline.title: Early Pure Veg Lunch
timeline.description: Warm South Indian thali or hot dosa at Udupi The Veg.

timeline.title: Collect Luggage & Move to KSRTC Covered Platform
timeline.description: Retrieve bags and wait under the covered shelter of Platform 0 at the bus stand.

timeline.title: Board KSRTC Airavat Club Class to Bengaluru
timeline.description: Board the bus (PNR: KS22879259, Seats: 5, 6) for the return journey to Kengeri TTMC.

timeline.title: Arrival at Kengeri TTMC & Auto Home
timeline.description: Alight at Kengeri TTMC and take an auto back to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya.
timeline.location: Kengeri TTMC to JDR Aadhitri, Kodipalya
